composition_subtypes.role: Sort cups by significance to enable greedy selection from most significant.
Two pointers expand informatics cups while contracting physics cups to maintain width constraint.

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort cups by significance, then use a two-pointer technique to optimally select high-significance cups from each subject within width limit.
payload.rationale: Sorting enables greedy selection by significance. The two-pointer approach efficiently explores all valid combinations of physics and informatics cups with amortized linear time.
